commit.message:
fix(vite): drop min_viewport_width from inline manifest

vite-plugin-pwa types reject unknown manifest fields (TS2353) and
min_viewport_width is platform-custom, not standard PWA. orientation
stays — it's a real PWA field. The central viewport-support check
treats min_viewport_width as a warn anyway, not a fail.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(compliance): declare orientation + --bg token

Two pre-existing central-compliance gaps that have been failing the
"Viewport support" and "Brand tokens defined" checks for the whole
game catalog:

- web/vite.config.ts inline PWA manifest now declares
  `orientation: "any"` and `min_viewport_width: 360`, so the storefront
  coverage badge has values to display and the central viewport-support
  check passes.
- web/src/index.css now defines `--bg` as an alias of `--paper`, so the
  brand-tokens check sees the game token (`--bg`) it expects for games.
  Existing rules using `var(--paper)` keep working unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(ci): PWA manifest check now finds vite-plugin-pwa output

The old check ran `find web/public -name "manifest.json"` which never
matches — vite-plugin-pwa emits `manifest.webmanifest` into `web/dist/`
during the build step that runs earlier in this same workflow. Update
the path and filename so the check actually verifies what gets shipped.

feat(multiplayer): share-link 1v1 via Cloudflare Durable Objects

Adds a "Play with friend" multiplayer mode. Click the people icon →
"Create game" → get a unique /g/{id} URL. Send it to a friend. They
join as the opposite color. Moves sync in real time, server-validated.

Architecture:
- web/public/_worker.js — Pages "advanced mode" Worker (single file)
  - GameDO class extends DurableObject — holds a chess.js instance +
    two WebSocket connections + game-over state
  - Routes:
    POST /api/game/new       → returns { id } (8-char alphanumeric)
    GET  /api/game/{id}/ws   → WebSocket upgrade to the DO for this id
    GET  /g/{id}             → serves index.html (SPA route)
    *                        → static asset fallback via env.ASSETS
  - Server validates every move; illegal/wrong-turn moves get a
    { type: "error" } reply, never get broadcast
- wrangler.jsonc — adds GAME binding + new_sqlite_classes migration
- web/src/components/MultiplayerTab.tsx — connection hook, share-link
  copy UI, status indicator, auto-reconnect on disconnect, resign +
  rematch buttons. Reuses Board + GameOverBanner + PlayerRow.
- web/src/App.tsx — adds Mode='multiplayer', /g/{id} route parsing,
  Users icon in topbar, RulesPanel section explaining multiplayer

Tested locally with wrangler pages dev + two browser tabs:
  - White creates game → unique URL
  - Black opens URL → joins, board flips, "Opponent" labeled
  - White plays e4 → black sees it within ~50ms, move list updates
  - Black replies e5 → white sees it, turn indicator flips
  - Server rejects out-of-turn moves
  - Connection state shown ("Connected · 2 players")

Constraints from platform CLAUDE.md: Free tier caps real-time rooms at
5 concurrent × 25 connections × 50 user-hours/day. Chess multiplayer
fits this easily — chess games are short and small-state.

Build: 285KB → 294KB JS (+9KB for MultiplayerTab). Server worker is
~5KB plus chess.js bundled by Pages.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: aim direction now matches spin direction

After flipping spin to camera-natural ("drag right = curve right"),
the AIM phase was left with the inverse mapping: dragging right or
pressing ArrowRight moved the ball to the camera-LEFT, because aimX
was still naive (positive = +X = camera-left in Babylon's left-handed
coords with the camera looking down -Z).

Same gesture, opposite effect across two adjacent phases — confusing.

Flipped both the drag delta (×-0.015 instead of ×+0.015) and the arrow
keys (ArrowLeft now +=, ArrowRight now -=) so all aim/spin controls
agree: right input = camera-right ball motion. aimX still represents
the ball's true world-X position, which keeps the render code clean.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Respect platform mute toggle in playTone

playTone() created a fresh AudioContext and an oscillator every time a
color flashed during the sequence and every time the player tapped a
color — none of that read the platform mute state, so the topbar Mute
button silently did nothing on simon.

Fix: playTone now takes muted as a third arg and early-returns if true.
The component reads useSound() once, stores it in a ref so the existing
useCallback hooks (showSequence, handlePress) don't have to be recreated
on every mute toggle, and passes mutedRef.current at the two call sites.

@freegamestore/compliance PWA-offline check:

  is precached (default 2 MB silently drops bigger chunks).

  so Google Fonts work on cold offline launch in iOS standalone.

  (e.g. stockfish.wasm) get precached.

  actually render legibly on a phone.

  shrink the centre without overflowing. The whole table now has a felt-

  counter, with a styled translucent panel so the round / turn / wall info
  is readable against the discards.

  wrapping into two rows on narrow phones.

  and then state cycled (turn changed, hand state no longer tenpai-able),
  the Cancel button vanished and the mode got stuck. Now we reset
  riichiMode the moment canRiichi flips false, and keep the toggle button
  visible whenever the mode is active.

  swapped to high-contrast yellow.
